meta.title: FlashGPU-Sim H100 · Vector Add / SM 指令
meta.description: Actual CPU execution of unmodified official FlashGPU-Sim at the pinned revision. H100 configuration; 256-element vector addition, 2 CTAs × 128 threads; all SMs sampled. ISSUE/STALL records are cycle observations, not execution durations or guaranteed complete issue coverage. Exact validation passed for all 256 outputs. No cross-run mapping to GTSim.

metrics.timingScope: Workload process from launch to exit, including simulator startup, PTX extraction, CPU simulation, functional validation, and native stdout/stderr writing; excludes source fetch, simulator/workload compilation, and JSON conversion. OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.
